              3,
              4
            ]
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Contact Your Bank: Call your bank's fraud or customer support team immediately. Inform them of the unauthorized transaction and request a chargeback or reversal. Block your debit or credit card, UPI, or net banking if your credentials are compromised.",

              1,
              2,
              3,
              5
            ]
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Save Evidence: Take screenshots of transaction IDs, chat histories, text messages, phone numbers, and payment app receipts. Do not delete any data."
